text.title: Go Backend Development Patterns Output Contract
text.summary: Pins the shape of a valid Go Backend Development Patterns output. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the actual answer / chosen option / value produced
at least 2 sentences; cites at least one input artefact by name
list of input names with source paths or URLs

forbidden.pattern: rationale that does not reference any input by name
inputs_used empty AND decision is not 'no-op'
duplicate artefact_id within the same store

allowed-transformations.transformation: Trim rationale to no more than 500 chars, preserving numeric claims and named tools.
Promote 'no decision yet' to status='pending' rather than fabricating a decision.
Group near-duplicate inputs, recording the group with member count.

section.title: Repo-shape contract (what the artefact describes)
section.p: The artefact above records the DECISION. This section pins the repo shape that decision must produce — it is the machine-checkable half, enforced by scripts/check-go-layout.py and templates/check-layout.sh.

example.code: github.com/acme/svc/ ├── cmd/ │ └── api/main.go # thin: config -> deps -> router -> server ├── internal/ │ ├── handler/ # thin handlers, ShouldBindJSON │ ├── service/ # business logic, defines UserRepository interface │ ├── repository/ # implements service interfaces │ ├── model/ # domain structs, no HTTP tags │ ├── middleware/ # ErrorHandler, Logger, RequestID │ └── config/ # envconfig binding ├── pkg/ # exported re-usables (rare) ├── migrations/ └── go.mod
example.note: internal/ never imported from outside the module. main.go imports only internal/* setup helpers.
Four rule violations in seven lines.

list.item: Every required field populated with a typed value
No forbidden pattern matches the output
cmd/api/main.go exists and imports config + deps + router + server, nothing else
No file outside the module imports `<module>/internal/`
Interfaces are declared in service/, not repository/
Every exported I/O function takes `ctx context.Context` as first arg
Handlers call `c.Error(err)` on failure, never `c.JSON` for errors
`Pool.Submit` selects on `ctx.Done()` as well as the jobs channel
